name: The Haber process and NPK fertilisers

terms.definition: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃: makes ammonia from nitrogen (air) and hydrogen (natural gas).
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Iron catalyst, about 450 °C, 200 atmospheres.

terms.definition: A lower temperature gives a higher yield but too slow a rate; a higher pressure gives a higher yield but costs more and is less safe.
Unreacted nitrogen and hydrogen are recycled; ammonia is removed by cooling, as it liquefies.
A formulation containing salts of nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium to improve plant growth.
A fertiliser made from ammonia and nitric acid.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Phosphate rock is treated with acids to make phosphate fertilisers.
